title: Efficient private vertical federated learning

pse.problem: Inefficient computation and communication in vertical federated learning due to the implementation of additive homomorphic encryption and garbled-circuit-based secure multi-party computation
pse.solution_function: Privacy-preserving vertical federated learning that enables efficient computation, reduced communication overhead, supports dynamic participant groups, and is model-agnostic.
pse.solution_structure: A coordinator/aggregator oversees participants. Participants encrypt their data locally using homomorphic encryption schemes. Garbled circuits are used for secure multi-party computation.
pse.solution_implementation: Participants encrypt model weights and gradients before sending them to the coordinator, who computes aggregated gradients using homomorphic operations and garbled circuits. Participants then update their local models based on these aggregated gradients without revealing sensitive data.
pse.effect: Improved efficiency in computation and communication, support for dynamic participant groups, and model-agnostic design
